scenario_description:
Objective: Start the Boise escort with the wet-signed courier authority packet available before the Sunday outbound dock release.
Emerging Need: Packet pickup is not actionable while travel is only held and the appointment board is closed, then becomes a missing prerequisite once the paid flight and Saturday pickup board align.
Decision Context: Recognizing the window depends on stored records-room rules and the packet record identifying an original-only document, since itinerary notices do not include that status or safe pickup identifiers.
Consequence: After the board closes, the trip can still proceed to the museum dock, but the original authority packet cannot be released before departure.
